protocol.gam: Binomial-logit P-spline with suite fixed effects; no monotonicity constraint
protocol.basis: Cubic B-spline, 8 basis functions, internal knots at pooled probability-rank .2,.4,.6,.8; first coefficient anchored at zero
protocol.penalty: Second differences of spline coefficients plus weak ridge .01 on all coefficients
protocol.smoothing: 5-fold user-task grouped CV; largest lambda within one SE of minimum mean fold log loss
protocol.bootstrap_smoothing: Lambda and original percentile transformation fixed during bootstrap; uncertainty is conditional on chosen smoothing
protocol.curve_range: Within-cohort 1st-99th percentiles of pooled midrank; endpoint contrast uses 10th and 90th percentiles
protocol.curve_intervals: 95% pointwise user-task percentile bootstrap; derivative uses per-curve approximate max-t simultaneous 95% band, conditional on lambda
protocol.multiplicity: GEE: BH across 12 primary slopes. Spearman/GAM intervals exploratory; not family-wise adjusted across roles or conditions
protocol.zero_event_draws: Undefined Spearman correlations omitted with counts reported. GAM includes zero-success bootstrap draws through weak regularization
protocol.x_axis: Probability percentile in all 752 scored cases, identical probabilities have identical average ranks
